title: The right side comes first
intro: Islam gives the right side priority – like the Prophet (SAW) did.

learn.html: Islam gives priority to the right side. Muhammad (SAW) gave the right side priority in everything he did, as much as he could. So we too:

items.label: Put on the right sleeve first
Put on the right shoe first
Take off the left sleeve first
Take off the left shoe first

learn.title: Hadith
learn.html: ‘A’ishah (RA) said: “The Prophet (SAW) liked to start with the right side when putting on his shoes, combing his hair, cleaning himself, and in all his affairs.” (Bukhari)

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: Putting on: right first. Taking off: left first. Eating and drinking: with the right hand.

practice.title: Right or left first?
practice.prompt: Which side do we start with?

questions.q: Which side has priority in Islam?
Which hand do we eat with?
Which shoe do we put on first?
Which sleeve do we take off first?
On which side do we sleep?

practice.title: Questions and task
prompts: 💬 Which side has priority? Which hand do we eat with?
🕌 In which things did Muhammad (SAW) start with the right side?
👟 Practise it: put your shoes and jacket on and off the right way!
